momentum: formation-month minus 12 month-end close to minus 1 month-end close: prior 2–12 returns, excluding formation month

beta.alignment: exact benchmark sessions; no missing-return interpolation

sector_peer_pool: All liquid/price-eligible names with complete beta and momentum inputs, including low-beta peers; archived sector labels, not historical SIC industries
primary_signal: own 2–12 return minus equal-weight mean of other eligible names in same sector
lag: rebalance at second benchmark session close strictly after formation; fixed targets formed earlier
exit: next scheduled rebalance; terminal holdings only marked, never forced sold
cost_model: solve post-cost equity = pre-cost equity minus rate times sum absolute change in stock notionals; targets use post-cost equity
controls: ordinary momentum, same beta/liquidity/peer and sector caps
all eligible high-beta equal-weight, sector weights capped at 20%, uninvested remainder cash
SPY total-return proxy, same initial entry date
primary_statistic: 5bp relative-minus-ordinary full-period proxy-return difference; withhold if either halts
secondary_statistics: monthly interval positive frequency, not broker trade win rate
ex-ante beta, turnover, exposure, overlap and selection counts
missing_held_prices: HALT_WITH_NO_FULL_PERIOD_RETURN; do not select using future completeness
provider_vintage: current retrospective vendor adjusted closes; not archived as-of publication
cash_dividend_assumption: embedded adjusted-price return proxy, not a verified broker reinvestment account
source_rule_status: 12–2 convention and relative-return hypothesis are literature-motivated; all high-beta/liquidity/weight/lag choices are DX27 research choices
changes_after_results: No threshold/ticker/horizon changes; disclose halts and retain failed cases
